hints.title: Core Insight
hints.text: Entering a neighboring cell at position (nr, nc) from time t requires waiting until at least moveTime[nr][nc], resulting in arrival time max(t, moveTime[nr][nc]) + 1.

hints.title: Algorithmic Structure
hints.text: Use a min-priority structure to always expand the reachable room with the smallest arrival time first.

hints.title: State Transitions
hints.text: Maintain a matrix of minimum known arrival times and stop once the destination room is popped from the priority structure.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Evaluates in optimal O(n * m * log(n * m)) runtime.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Brute-force exhaustive search exceeds the time limit.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Uses O(n * m) auxiliary memory for optimal state tracking.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identifies optimal pattern to achieve O(n * m * log(n * m)) complexity.
